usedFor: New Pipedrive activities post to Slack so the team sees calls and follow-ups.

bestTemplate.name: “New Activity Created” in Pipedrive, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Activities are daily Pipedrive work, and “Send Message” accepts a channel name or ID.

watchOut: “New Activity Created” polls, so Slack hears about a Pipedrive activity late, and the post waits for approval.
